knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A packed kit keeps items reachable during the route. The kit is not a substitute for the site card and does not set start times.
The route does not start with missing or wrong liners. A restock is raised first.
Damage such as sharp edges, cracks or loose wheels is checked on the bin and tote before use.

practicalCriteria: Packs the kit from the site card list, including liners in the sizes listed, cloths, sanitiser, drop sheet, scoop and personal protective equipment.
Inspects the bin and tote and removes any damaged item from use before starting.
Raises a restock request in writing for any shortage found before leaving the storage room.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% pass mark, which for three questions means all three correct. Practical sign-off is separate and observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Kit check recorded on the job sheet
Assessor observation of the kit packing
stopWorkCriteria: Route started with a bin that has a sharp edge or crack
Route started with a known shortage of the correct liner size
